content: I prefer short, direct answers. Never claim success without test evidence.
Understood. core/context_builder.py imports core/vector_store.py and core/graph_store.py to merge both memory types.
The memory_char_limit is 2200 and the user_char_limit is 1375. Those are hard limits, never exceed them.
core/memory_curator.py writes to data/vector_store.db for knowledge and data/graph_store.db for experience.
My timezone is Asia/Kuala_Lumpur and Faisal is the final approval authority for any deploy.
Config rule: retrieval top_k stays at 5 for both stores until we benchmark it.
The vector store depends on sqlite3 from the standard library; no external vector database is required.
